## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and her mother. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly become friends in the garden, solemnly swearing eternal friendship. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her new friend, and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) surprises [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of chocolate sweeties.
>

> While attending school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is taunted by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who calls her 'Carrots' and pulls her hair. Enraged, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head, leading Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) to punish her by making her stand at the blackboard. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proudly rejects Gilbert's attempt to apologize.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) during the night, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to a fall that breaks Anne's ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visitors, reflects on her mistakes, and looks forward to returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and flourishes under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) organizes a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a school flag, throwing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the other students into excited preparations despite Marilla's skepticism. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her upcoming concert roles with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), finding steady support and encouragement in [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> Noticing how plainly [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is dressed compared to her friends, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) attempts to buy her a trendy puffed-sleeve dress at a store, though he ends up flustered and gets help from Mrs. Lynde instead. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the stylish dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) as well as a pair of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). She later wears her new outfit to the school concert, where she performs brilliantly.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) present of kid slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). They participate in the evening concert, which is a great success, and walk home together discussing the performances. Afterward, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit by the fire and express their pride in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), briefly discussing her future education.
>

> On her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) down the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing their growing up and Anne's melodramatic composition assignment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proposes starting a story club, which quickly expands to include other schoolmates. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the club and its moral lessons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home to find [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hiding in her room after accidentally dying her red hair a terrible shade of green using dye bought from a peddler. When washing the dye out fails, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) cuts Anne's hair short, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later resolves to bear the resulting embarrassment as penance.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a restful, active summer outdoors on the [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) doctor's orders before returning to her studies in autumn. As the school year progresses, she prepares intensely for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams under Miss Stacy's guidance. Meanwhile, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) observes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) growing up into a quieter, taller young woman and privately grieves the passing of Anne's childhood.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxiously awaits the results of the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joyful news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. Lynde before going to sleep feeling grateful.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), assisted by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and checked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After driving over with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) experiences severe stage fright on the hotel platform, but recovers upon seeing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd and performs brilliantly to enthusiastic applause.
>

> Following her successful recitation and encore at the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is warmly praised by the guests, including a stout pink lady and Mrs. [Evans](../character/evans.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) join [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for supper before they leave with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) in his carriage, chatting about wealth, compliments from an artist, and being content with who they are.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) plans on their drive home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) when they spot a Jersey cow trampling Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the cow is her own nuisance Jersey, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impulsively sells the stray cow on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) still in the barnyard and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to head over to his house with the money and a cake to confess.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as they drive through the countryside to canvass for hall repairs. They visit several local residents, dealing with the pessimistic Miss [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md), receiving a secret donation from Catherine, helping Dan Blair mix a cake, and navigating Mrs. Theodore White's extreme cleanliness to gather subscriptions.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) residents, visiting Mrs. Theodore White and several other neighbors with varying degrees of success. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) has just had a son, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cleverly visits him while he is overjoyed and secures a five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he refuses.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) debate Mrs. Lynde's virtues and discuss the village hall painting project. Later, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint numbers, causing dismay among the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite the hideous result, public sympathy turns in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the community rallies around them.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meet by the stream and make plans to celebrate Anne's chosen spring birthday on Saturday. When Saturday arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) go on a woods walk, naming a hidden pool and exploring back lanes. Eventually, they discover Hester Gray's forgotten garden, where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the touching romantic history of the spot.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P0](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0000), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044)_

> After reflecting on Hester Gray's story and imagining her appearance, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) spend the afternoon exploring the woods and eating lunch by a brook. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her poetic thoughts about nature and souls, which [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) finds hard to grasp. As evening falls, the girls return home after a wonderful day, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later leaves narcissus blossoms on Hester's grave.
>

> Mrs. Lynde tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about preparations for the Ladies' [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar and asks to borrow Miss Barry's platter, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns Marilla's sight is improving. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) receives a letter from the twins' uncle extending their stay, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remembers a conversation with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted ads, prompting a committee of girls to try unsuccessfully to talk him out of it.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) plead with [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for advertising, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally witnesses [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) offering Judson a political bribe. To ensure [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) keeps quiet and doesn't ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to drop the advertisement plan and tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) can have their way.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) frantically decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a elaborate dinner for the arrival of the famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally destroys the lemon pies, the guest of honor fails to arrive, and a series of mishaps ruins the meal and results in Miss Barry's expensive platter being broken. A later letter reveals Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her bitter disappointment.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

> After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns via a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) due to a sprained ankle. Sitting on the porch at twilight, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's tendency toward high hopes and deep disappointments, how to replace Aunt Josephine's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md).
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P65](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0065), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P67](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0067)_

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about where sleep goes before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) alerts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to Diana's signal fire. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Diana's house and learns about a potential willow-ware platter at the Copp place in [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale). The next day, the girls travel to [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally breaks through the roof of an outhouse while peeping through a window to inspect the platter, trapping herself until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and chops her free.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P16](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0016), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains her actions to [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp and agrees to purchase the desired willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars. After enjoying tea and learning that [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) plans to marry, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive home along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) with the platter in hand.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P56](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0056), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away, [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), covered in feathers and having accidentally dyed her nose red, quickly cleans herself up. With help from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hosts a successful and delightful visit for her distinguished guests.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid Charlotta the Fourth at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her imaginary party and the origin of her echoes. After [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) demonstrates the echoing tin horn and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her maid's given name, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) briefly inquires about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son before bidding the girls a wistful goodbye.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) expresses concern about the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaving for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). They talk about their romantic ideals, Ruby Gillis's suitors, and their lifelong friendship, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warmly acknowledges.
>
